producerRepresentationBoundary.instructions: Preview 0x82D2B450/B454/B458 uses word multiply, masked word rotate and full-register add; credit 0x82D2B5CC/B5D0/B5D4/B5D8 adds a preceding H*M word product. For signed word product x immediately before the rotate, the complete result is R(x)=uint64(int64(x))+uint64(uint32(uint32(x)<<2)), modulo 2^64. A low-word-only edit or unconditional sign extension does not preserve that representation.
producerRepresentationBoundary.boundedIdentity: At most 257 signed-byte factors contribute: one carrier and up to 256 scanned records. Own multipliers are at most 3 and H is at most 2, so |H*W|<=197376. Over this bound neither word product overflows signed32, and R(x) equals uint64(uint32(5*x)). The full-register result is therefore zeroextended low32 throughout this supported model, including negative factors. This is not an unconstrained identity for arbitrary register inputs.

conclusion: The selected sale path sums carrier and linked-unit factors before applying the carrier's army/fleet multiplier to the entire sum. For the supported Galleon/Spy inputs this derives75 Gold per ordinary Spy inside a fleet, matching the reported cargo contribution. A distinct native command credits that amount and a later request deletes the selected unit. Actual invocation/delivery and a coherent preview-plus-credit correction remain unverified.
